body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Harman International presented its portable GPS ''guide+play (model:GPS-500) during CES 2007. As the name indicates, you can use it as GPS on the road or as a portable media player at ordinary times. It has 4-inch WQVGA touch screen, digital map of Canada and USA, audio playback. It supports English, French, and Spanish.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
